mapper.select: SELECT brokerage.current_balance AS account_value, COALESCE(brokerage.available_balance, 0) AS cash_balance, brokerage.last_synced_at AS market_data_as_of FROM connected_account brokerage INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = brokerage.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND brokerage.account_id = #{accountId} AND brokerage.status = 'ACTIVE' AND brokerage.business_type = 'ST' LIMIT 1
